name: copypastegenius-vscode
description:
Your prompt library, inside VS Code. Run AI skills without breaking your flow.

Stop switching tabs to copy prompts. CopyPasteGenius connects directly to your skill library on copypastegenius.com and lets you run any skill from inside the editor — highlight code, pick a skill, and get a fully assembled prompt copied to your clipboard or inserted at your cursor. Works with Claude, ChatGPT, or any AI tool you already use.

## What It Does

CopyPasteGenius bridges the gap between your prompt library and your code editor. Instead of manually copying prompts, filling in variables, and pasting them into an AI chat, the extension handles the assembly automatically — right where you're working.

- Browse your skills from a dedicated sidebar panel, organized by category
- Run a skill on any selection — highlight a function, a block, a snippet, and the extension auto-fills {{code}}, {{language}}, {{text}}, and more
- Fill remaining variables via a quick-pick dialog, then get the finished prompt delivered your way
- Three output modes: copy to clipboard, insert at cursor, or open in a panel

## Key Features

Sidebar skill browser — All your skills, organized by category, always visible in the Activity Bar. Click any skill to run it instantly.

Right-click context menu — Select code in any file, right-click, and choose CPG: Run Skill on Selection. The extension auto-fills your selection and detects the language.

Smart variable auto-fill — {{language}} is auto-detected from the active file type. {{code}}, {{text}}, {{content}}, {{selection}} are filled from your highlighted text. Remaining variables are prompted in a quick-pick.

Flexible output — Choose where your assembled prompt lands: clipboard (default), inline at cursor position, or a dedicated output panel.

## Example Workflow

1. Open a Python file and highlight a function you want reviewed
2. Right-click → CPG: Run Skill on Selection
3. Pick Code Review from the quick-pick list
4. {{language}} auto-fills as Python, {{code}} auto-fills with your selection
5. Fill any remaining custom variables
6. Prompt is copied to clipboard — paste into Claude or ChatGPT and go

## Requirements

- VS Code 1.85 or later
- A CopyPasteGenius account with Pro access
- API key from Settings → API Keys on copypastegenius.com

Works with Claude, ChatGPT, and any AI assistant that accepts text prompts.
